Class ScenarioPreviewPaneBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioPreviewPaneBuilder
public class ScenarioPreviewPaneBuilder extends Object
Controller and renderer for the interactive cartographic preview pane in the Scenario Setup Panel.

Supports multi-layer rendering across equirectangular 2D and orthographic spherical representations: \[ (x, y) = \mathcal{P}(\lambda, \phi) = \left( R (\lambda - \lambda_0) \cos \phi_0, R \phi \right) \] with dynamic hillshade elevation blending: \[ I_{\text{shade}} = \max\left(0, \cos \theta_z \cos \beta + \sin \theta_z \sin \beta \cos(\phi_{\text{sun}} - \alpha)\right) \] and real-time demographic and cultural tensor visualization.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
